messages:
Nina L: Marketplace engineer asked for a KMS/HSM attestation in addition to SOC2 and pen-test evidence for the HW+SI listing. They want confirmation keys are customer-isolated and an HSM diagram.
Omar: I can own the KMS/HSM attestation. Ill pull the HSM cert, key separation diagram, and short ops note on key lifecycle.
Priya (SI): SI needs to confirm how we store partner keys in our integration. We currently use envelope encryption with customer KEKs in their tenant. Ill document that and attach a sample config (redacted).
Legal: Heads up: attestation language needs to avoid operational commitments beyond current docs. Use the approved attestation template and cc me before sending to marketplace.
InfraBot: Created secure upload path: s3://marketplace-evidence/hw-si-789/hsm-attestation/. Presign TTL default 24h. Use multipart for >50MB.
Nina L: Marketplace also asked for a bridge letter if SOC2 period ends before listing date. Do we have a bridge letter template?
Omar: Yes, we have a bridge letter template in /security/templates/bridge-letter-v2.docx. Ill populate with current control status and last audit date.
Priya (SI): Pen-test note: vendor will provide an attestation of no high findings for public listing. Full report goes to secure reviewers only. Need to confirm redaction owner for any sample config or IPs.
Omar: Redaction owner = Priya. Ill provide HSM artifacts marked as non-PII. Priya please redact sample configs and bump anything customer-specific.
Nina L: Quick checklist for listing metadata we agreed on: [KMS attestation, HSM diagram (PDF), SOC2 redacted bundle or bridge letter, pen-test attestation, vulnerability scan summary]. If any piece missing we tag listing as "evidence-pending".
MarketplaceOps: Please attach the HSM diagram as a PDF and the attestation. Well need to show "customer key isolation: yes" in the listing UI.
Legal: Ill review attestation copy within 24h of receiving draft. Reminder: dont include live key IDs or ARNs in public artifacts. Use placeholders like <KMS_KEY_ID>.
Priya (SI): Timeline: pen-test attestation by Apr 10, redacted SOC2 bundle or bridge letter by Apr 9, HSM artifacts by Apr 7. Sync Thurs 11:00 to verify.
InfraBot: Calendar invite created: "Marketplace HSM/KMS compliance sync" Thu 11:00. Files uploaded to s3 path above when ready; request presigns here.
Nina L: Thanks everyone. If any delays, mark the listing metadata and ping MarketplaceOps so they can hold the announcement.
